profile.headline: Software Engineer | Bachelor's in Computer Science

positions.title: AI/ML Scientist, Software Developer
positions.description:
• Research novel AI/ML methodologies applicable to pharmacometric modeling or improving internal efficiency
• Build, maintain, and improve software applications developed by ePD
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning · Quantitative Research · Full-Stack Development · Pharmacometrics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Scaled internal CRM into SaaS Offering; onboarding Life Storage, now Extra Space, as the inaugural client
• Spearheaded Data Engineering
    • Normalized PostgreSQL database to 3NF with Json based EAV system
    • Planned and implemented audit strategies utilizing hybrid SCD Type 2 store
    • Created ELT data integrations for customer onboarding and Changed Data Capture
• Modernized Frontend
    • Migrated frameworks, added responsiveness, and reimagined the UI & UX experience
    • Collaborated with consulting design firm to develop style system and component library in Figma
    • Reduced average user story loading time by 65%
• Contributed to Developer Operation and Quality Assurance Practices
    • Built upon functional, integration, and architecture testing suites
    • Expanded CI/CD pipelines with GitHub actions and containerization practices with Docker
    • Assisted backend architecture refactor with the addition of enforced type safety
• Developed Core Functionalities; such as, Data Management Tooling, Document Generation, And Reporting
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · HTMX · PostgreSQL · Tailwind CSS · Data Build Tool (DBT)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Consulted for pre-release development of Finch Studio, an IDE for pharmacometric analysis
• Refactored codebase for architectural consistency and code reusability
• Led stakeholder and standup meetings to ensure product direction in highly technical domain
• Implemented performant simulation runtime data analytical tools in d3.js library
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · JavaScript · Vue.js · Electron.js · D3.js

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Diagnosed inefficiencies in communication, data, and process experienced working dispatch
• Green-fielded proprietary ERP solution, resulting in an estimated savings of 4,800 hours of engineer time and over $2,000,000 in cost avoidance from 2019 - 2023
• Integrated existing data tooling including MSSQL instance, MS Suite, and SAP Crystal Reports
• Trained users, generated usage documentation, and documented codebase
• Supported application on a by need basis until it’s sunset in Q4 2023
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · SQL · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
